Definition: a guard (the man, the post or the prison); a deposit (figuratively); also (as observed) a usage (abstractly), or an example (concretely)
BiblicalUsage: The word is a guard, a watch, a ward, and it runs from prison to the heart. Joseph was put in ward and kept there, Nehemiah set a watch against the enemy day and night, and the Proverb says to keep the heart with all diligence, for out of it are the issues of life.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the heart is the ward that matters most: prisons hold the body, but the watch over the heart holds the life.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Son of Jacob; Nehemiah; King Solomon
